PowerShell(python -c "import json; data=json.load\(open\(r'E:\\SSEPI\\inventario electronica\\data.json','r',encoding='utf-8'\)\); print\('Total items:', len\(data\)\); print\('Keys:', list\(data[0].keys\(\)\)\); u1=[i for i in data if i.get\('Unnamed: 1',''\)!='']; u2=[i for i in data if i.get\('Unnamed: 2',''\)!='']; u4=[i for i in data if i.get\('Unnamed: 4',''\)!='']; u5=[i for i in data if i.get\('Unnamed: 5',''\)!='']; u6=[i for i in data if i.get\('Unnamed: 6',''\)!='']; print\('Non-empty Unnamed:1:', len\(u1\), 'Unnamed:2:', len\(u2\), 'Unnamed:4:', len\(u4\), 'Unnamed:5:', len\(u5\), 'Unnamed:6:', len\(u6\)\); costs=[i['COSTO UNITARIO MXN'] for i in data if i['COSTO UNITARIO MXN']]; print\('Cost range:', min\(costs\), '-', max\(costs\), 'MXN'\); print\('Total value:', sum\(i['TOTAL LINEA MXN'] for i in data if i['TOTAL LINEA MXN']\), 'MXN'\)")
